description: Adapting To Rising Tides Bay Shoreline Flood Explorer is a dataset listed in State of California open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by San Francisco Bay Conservation and Development Commission. The Adapting to Rising Tides program has developed this website to help Bay Area communities prepare for the impacts of current and future flooding due to sea level rise and storm surges by learning about causes of flooding, exploring maps of flood risk along our shoreline, and downloading the data for further analysis. Coverage: California. The portal files it under the publisher San Francisco Bay Conservation and Development Commission. Its tags are ART, ART Bay Area, BCDC, Bay Area, CAOpenData. It offers 2 resource(s) in ARCGIS GEOSERVICES REST API, HTML. The portal shows 2026-09-24 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support natural hazard exposure and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-ca-portal.
